# Code of Conduct

`go-oidc-provider` adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1][cc] as
its code of conduct. The full text is published at the link below; the
project's contributors, maintainers, issue authors, and pull-request
reviewers all agree to abide by it when participating in this
repository, in associated discussion forums, and at events held in the
project's name.

[cc]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

## Reporting

To report unacceptable behaviour, contact the maintainer privately:

- GitHub Security Advisories (works for non-security CoC reports as a
  private channel too): <https://github.com/libraz/go-oidc-provider/security/advisories/new>
- Email: see the maintainer profile at <https://github.com/libraz>

Reports are reviewed in confidence. Maintainers will respond with the
action taken or with a request for additional information within a
reasonable timeframe.

## Scope

The Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces and to anyone
representing the project in public spaces. This includes — but is not
limited to — issues, pull requests, code reviews, commit messages,
release notes, project-affiliated chat channels, and conference talks
that reference the project.

## Enforcement

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying expectations, addressing
violations, and applying remediation up to and including a permanent
ban from the project's spaces. The full set of community-impact
guidelines (correction → warning → temporary ban → permanent ban) is
defined by the Contributor Covenant 2.1 text linked above; this file
intentionally does not duplicate that text so it cannot drift from the
upstream source.
